title: POP Subgraph
tagline: A subgrpah for a dao building tool using data source templates
description:
This project provides an on-chain data indexing layer for a DAO creation tool. Using subgraph templates, it standardizes how DAO events and state changes are tracked, making it easy to query proposals, votes, and executions in real time. The goal is to give builders and communities a flexible and reliable way to plug governance data directly into their apps.

how_its_made: Built with The Graph’s data source templates for modular subgraph generation. Solidity contracts emit the events, mappings are written in AssemblyScript, and the subgraph is deployed to The Graph Network. The setup ensures upgradeability, efficient indexing, and easy integration with DAO frontends.
